probe.scope: RTC/entropy source adapter replay on the fixed real guest. Full Linux provider replay remains gated by completion/network adapters.

program.scope: RTC read/latch, alarm arm and background poll, time-set halves, exact RNG DMA and deterministic CLINT/WFI idle advance; all external source observations are recorded.
